title: Toyota 2018-2021 (Camry, RAV4, Corolla, Highlander and more): small coolant leak at the flow shut-off valve, program 24TE04
summary: Toyota Customer Support Program 24TE04: a small coolant leak from the flow shut-off valve can drip onto other parts and bring up "Engine Maintenance Required" or make the A/C act up. Once verified, the valve (or the water by-pass hose assembly it's part of) is replaced; secondary coverage runs 10 years / 100,000 miles.

specs.name: Program
specs.value: Customer Support Program 24TE04, announced to dealers December 5, 2024

specs.name: Secondary coverage
specs.value: 10 years from date of first use or 100,000 miles, whichever first

specs.name: Vehicles
specs.value: Certain 2019-2021 Avalon / Avalon HV, 2018-2021 Camry / Camry HV, 2020-2021 Corolla, 2019-2021 Corolla HB, 2020-2021 Highlander, 2019-2021 RAV4 / RAV4 HV, 2021 RAV4 PHV, 2021 Sienna HV, 2021 Venza

specs.name: Other models' repair
specs.value: Replace the water by-pass hose assembly

specs.name: Salvage / branded title
specs.value: Still eligible: the program is emission related

steps.text: Symptoms: "Engine Maintenance Required" on the cluster, A/C not working normally, or coolant dripping onto nearby parts.
Verify the leak is coming from the flow shut-off valve. The program only pays for verified cases.

Repair with the new countermeasure valve (Corolla, Corolla HB) or water by-pass hose assembly (the other models). Look the part up by VIN; Toyota added newer countermeasure part numbers in August 2026.
Technical instructions are in the TSB named in the dealer letter (example given: 24-TMS-0044-T). Owners who already paid may be reimbursed per the owner letter.

body: The dealer letter's model table is laid out in columns that don't all line up in the PDF text; the model list here follows the program memo (source 2), which names every model and year range in plain text. Hybrid versions match by name here (CAMRY matches CAMRY HYBRID); the program covers both.
